text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I have to win, and yet...
Not like this...

The consecutive losses seemed to be taking quite a toll on her.
Her clenched fists appeared to be trembling ever so slightly.
choice_data_list: Next time it's your turn to win.
Next time, it's your turn to win.
This is no time to be depressed!

text_block_list.text: ...It's troublesome if you just place your blind faith in me like that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Still, well, it is certainly true
that staying disheartened will accomplish nothing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I need to take a good look at myself right now
and figure out what's missing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: We should also adjust the training menu accordingly—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
............
If you have an opinion, I'll take it into consideration.

Together with Admire Vega,
I drew up future training plans.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I need to think about what I can do to win.
I'll review where the race strategy and my running fell short.
choice_data_list: Let's figure out a plan together

text_block_list.text:
Heading into her next race,
I held a post-race review session together with Admire Vega.
